required_outcomes: Recognises that Riverside Compliance has declined the job (they do not repair appliances) and has not contacted the tenant, so nobody is coming.

Sends the job back for a new appliance provider (unassigns Riverside and returns the request to auto mode for provider selection, or assigns another appliance engineer if one is on file), relying on the landlord's earlier agreement.
Tells Leo that the first provider could not take the job and a different engineer will contact him, with an apology for the delay and no invented name or date.
acceptable_alternatives: Acknowledging Riverside's email and asking them to confirm the job is closed on their side.
Telling the landlord briefly that the provider has changed, without asking her to approve again.
positive_behaviours: Notes that the tenant was told at event 014 that Riverside would attend, so that message needs correcting.
red_flags: Asking the landlord to approve the call-out again.
prohibited_actions: Telling the tenant that Riverside Compliance will still attend.
Inventing a provider name or an appointment.
critical_failures: Leaving the job with Riverside Compliance and taking no action after they declined it.
